text:
zoe (product): quick thread 1: customers asking for a concise onramp for enterprise compliance: audit export shape, BYOK/KMS handshake, retention lanes, and what we can promise in contracts. need a minimal, testable MVP.
hassan (eng): propose MVP scope: cloud-KMS BYOK (store key-ref only), 90d hot index with on-demand NDJSON export, tenant retention flag + TTL job. no cold-archive in MVP.
lucy (security): add items: include kms-key-id in every audit row, log handshake attestation token when present, and provide key-rotation events. require threat-model doc for any pilot.
matt (sales): two pilots: AlpineBank needs HSM attest before prod; BetaApps ok with cloud-KMS. Alpine may accept partner attestation path. timeline ask: 6-8 weeks for pilot delivery.
olga (custeng): BetaApps wants fast recent-search (<10m) and on-demand export by tenant. They can accept phased rollout.
zoe (product): draft acceptance tests (short): 1) BYOK handshake: POST /v1/keystore/handshake -> returns key-ref; verify audit contains key-ref + status. 2) Export: GET /v1/audit/export?tenant&start&end -> returns NDJSON matching schema v1 with chain-of-custody headers. 3) Retention: set tenant retention=7y, run TTL job -> verify deletion marker in export snapshot.
hassan (eng): note: recent-search <10m requires hot index. 7y will be cold and paginated; exports for cold ranges will be slower. I'll include cost delta.
lucy (security): for AlpineBank, offer partner attestation (PartnerHSM) and document acceptance: attestation token present in handshake audit entry. include regression checks for request-id, model-version, tenant-id, route, kms-key-id.
compliance-bot: ticket COMP-83321 created: "Onramp checklist: BYOK + audit export MVP" assigned to product/eng/security.
deb (legal): draft contract language: acceptance = passing staged acceptance tests + sample export review. avoid "absolute deletion" promises; define TTL semantics and escrow options.
zoe (product): next steps: hassan + lucy to produce tech spec + test harness by EOW; deb to draft contract clause; matt to prioritize Alpine vs BetaApps; olga to schedule BetaApps kickoff. keep Phase A small. :eyes:
